# Sonder Digital Co.

> A software and automation studio in Atlanta, Georgia. Sonder builds custom AI agents,
> workflow automation, custom software and websites for established businesses, and the
> founder designs and builds every system himself.

Home: https://www.sonderdigitalco.com
Start: https://calendly.com/chase-sonderdigital-co/30min (a 30-minute discovery call)
Email: chase@sonderdigital-co.com

## Who it is for

Owners and operators of established businesses, most often companies that sell by
quote or estimate and have years of customer history sitting in a CRM, a spreadsheet or
an older system: commercial sign companies, trade-show exhibit houses, hardscape and
outdoor-living contractors, pool and deck builders, generator dealers. Also private
medical practices and clinics, nonprofits and youth sports organizations, and coaches
and creatives who need a website that does a job.

It is not for consumers, and it is not a lead-generation agency.

## What Sonder builds

- **Lead reactivation and quote follow-up.** Revives estimates that went quiet and
  clients who stopped booking. Automatic, personal follow-up on a schedule, written
  from the details of each quote; every reply stops the sequence and goes to the right
  person. Installed on the quoting or booking system the business already uses.
- **AI agents and intelligent systems.** AI receptionists, virtual assistants and
  customer-support agents that answer questions, qualify leads and book appointments,
  working from rules the owner approves.
- **Voice AI receptionist.** A branded phone agent that answers every call 24/7, routes
  it where it belongs and books appointments.
- **Workflow automation and integrations.** Connects the tools a business already runs
  (quoting, inbox, calendar, payments, CRM) so information moves on its own.
- **Custom software and development.** Custom CRMs, internal dashboards, client portals,
  business applications, and the websites and web applications customers see.
- **Sales and customer systems.** Follow-up that actually happens: quote recovery,
  re-booking, win-back and the CRM to track it.
- **HOTMA policy updates for public housing authorities.** A gap check and board-ready
  rewrite of an ACOP or HCV Administrative Plan for HUD's HOTMA income and asset rules.
  Details: https://www.sonderdigitalco.com/housing-policy

## How an engagement works

Discover (a 30-minute call about how the business runs and where the opportunity is),
Design (a written scope and fixed price), Build (built by the founder, with working
versions shown as it goes, connected to the tools already in use), Refine (launch, then
tuning on real use, with monthly care where wanted).
